name: hister
title: Hister
description: Search the full text of every page you've visited, indexed by your own Hister server.
author: KevinBatdorf

commands.name: search
commands.title: Search Hister
commands.subtitle: Hister
commands.description: Full-text search over the pages and files your Hister server has indexed.

tools.name: search-pages
tools.title: Search Pages
tools.description: Full-text search over the pages and files the user has visited, as indexed by their Hister server.

tools.name: read-page
tools.title: Read Page
tools.description: Read the stored text of one page from the user's Hister index.

ai.instructions: Hister is the user's personal search engine over pages they have visited and files they keep. Use search-pages to find pages, then read-page when the answer needs what a page actually says. Cite pages as markdown links with their titles.

preferences.name: accessToken
preferences.title: Access Token
preferences.description: The access_token from your Hister config, or your profile's token on a multi-user server. Leave empty if your server has none.

scripts.prepublishOnly:
echo "

It seems like you are trying to publish the Raycast extension to npm.

If you did intend to publish it to npm, remove the \`prepublishOnly\` script and rerun \`npm publish\` again.
If you wanted to publish it to the Raycast Store instead, use \`npm run publish\` instead.

" && exit 1
